# Attribute reference

<!-- Generated by `node tools/api.ts` from the source; do not edit. `pnpm vp run docs` checks it is current. -->

Every element class the library ships, in the order of the registry: where it goes, what it holds, and every attribute with its type. The text of each attribute is the first sentence of the source's own comment, then its default if it has one; the pages of the guide give the rest.

**Every element** also takes `id` (a name other elements and JSON refer to it by), `meta` (`{ title, description, role, aria }`: [Accessibility](../guide/accessibility.md)), `visible` (false hides it and everything in it), and `style` (a block of looks by selector: [Styling](../guide/styling.md)). Attribute names with hyphens nest in JSX and markup: `meta-title="x"`, `regularDomain-start={0}`.

## Chart

The root: a theme, a size, and what is drawn on it.

**In** none (the root) · **Holds** planes, ChartTitle, Legend, Cursor, ColorAxis, SizeAxis, ColorKey, SizeKey, ChartSummary

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `theme` (required) | `BaseTheme` | Every default look: required, so a chart bundles exactly the theme it names (`lightTheme`, `darkTheme`, or your own). |
| `width` | `number` | Width of the drawing. Default: whatever the platform reports, followed as it changes. |
| `height` | `number` | Height of the drawing. Default: whatever the platform reports. |
| `padding` | `number \| Partial<Insets>` | Margin around everything, in pixels: one number for all sides, or any subset of the four. Default 10. |
| `measureText` | `TextMeasurer` | Replaces the platform's text measurement, e.g. to match a font the platform cannot see. |
| `locale` | `string` | A BCP 47 tag (`'de'`, `'fr-CA'`) for how numbers and dates are written: digit grouping, the decimal mark, month names. Default: numbers as plain digits with a point, and the runtime's own locale for dates. |
| `transition` | `{ duration?: number; easing?: string; views?: boolean }` | Ease the chart to a new drawing when its **data** changes, in the browser: colours, sizes and (in browsers that can morph a path, Chrome and Firefox) the shapes of lines, areas and bars move over `duration` milliseconds (default 250) with a CSS `easing` (default `'ease-out'`). |
| `onFlush` | `(stats: FlushStats) => void` | Called after every flush with its statistics. |

## ChartTitle

Text across the top or bottom: a title, subtitle or caption.

**In** Chart · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `text` (required) | `string` | The words. |
| `role` | `TitleRole` | What it is, which decides its look and (unless `side` says) where it goes. Default 'title'. |
| `side` | `'top' \| 'bottom'` | The edge it spans. Default: the top, except for a caption, which goes at the bottom. |

## ChartTooltip

A box of text at the cursor.

**In** Cursor · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `follow` | `boolean` | Whether the box moves with the cursor, with no arm, or is set beside what is read, with an arm to it. Default: moves with the cursor when the cursor is 'shared' (there is no one point to be beside), else set beside the point. |
| `swatch` | `boolean` | A sample of the series (its line, box or marker, as drawn on the plot) before its name, or without one before its first line. Default false. |
| `format` | `(hit: Hit) => string` | The text for one hit. Default: the series name, then each coordinate (with its axis' title if it has one) and the channels. |
| `announce` | `boolean` | Tell a screen reader what the box says when the cursor is moved by keyboard (see `Platform.announce`), so it can be read without seeing it. Default true. |

## ChartSummary

A spoken summary of the chart, for screen readers (English, replaceable).

**In** Chart · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `(facts: ChartFacts) => string` | Words the facts. Default: English sentences. |
| `roleDescription` | `string` | What the chart is, as a screen reader announces it. Default 'chart'. |

## Cursor

Finds what the pointer or keyboard is on; its children draw it.

**In** Chart · **Holds** Crosshair, ChartTooltip

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `'nearest' \| 'shared'` | What it finds: the 'nearest' point, or every series 'shared' at its place along the first axis. Default 'nearest'. |
| `interpolate` | `boolean` | Read the line between its two points at the cursor instead of reporting a point. Default false. |
| `plane` | `ElementRef<Plane>` | The plane it works in. Default: the plane the pointer is over, and the first plane for the keyboard. |
| `keys` | `CursorKeys \| false` | Keys for moving it from the keyboard, or `false` for none (and no tab stop). |

## Crosshair

Guide lines through the cursor.

**In** Cursor · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `lines` | `'first' \| 'second' \| 'both'` | Which guide: the line of constant first coordinate (across a line chart: vertical), of the second, or both. Default 'both'. |
| `dots` | `boolean` | A dot in the series' colour on each reading under the cursor. Default false. |
| `dotSize` | `number` | Radius of those dots, in pixels. Default 4. |
| `snap` | `boolean` | Put the lines through the first reading (a point) rather than through the cursor itself. Default false. |

## Legend

Lists the named series; click to hide or show.

**In** Chart · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `side` | `Side` | The edge of the chart it sits along. Default 'right'. |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | Entries in a column or a row. Default: along its side, so a column on the left and right, a row on the top and bottom. |
| `title` | `string` | A heading above the entries. |
| `toggle` | `boolean` | Clicking an entry hides or shows its series. Default true. |

## CartesianPlane

A rectangular plot (x and y).

**In** Chart · **Holds** Axis, series, Stack, LineAnnotation, CalloutAnnotation, PointAnnotations, PanZoom, BoxZoom, Brush, PointerListener

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `gridlines` | `boolean` | Lines at the first horizontal and first vertical axis' ticks. Default true. |
| `frame` | `boolean` | Draw a border round the plot area, above the series. |
| `clip` | `boolean` | Clip series to the plot area. Default true. |
| `insets` | `Partial<Insets>` | Fixed margins round the plot (room for axes). |

## PolarPlane

A disc: angle and radius.

**In** Chart · **Holds** as CartesianPlane

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `startAngle` | `number` | Radians clockwise from twelve o'clock. Default 0. |
| `sweep` | `number` | Radians swept by the angle axis, clockwise; negative runs the other way. Default 2π. |
| `innerRadius` | `number` | Fraction of the radius left empty in the middle. Default 0. |
| `gridlines` | `boolean` | Rings at the radius axis' ticks and spokes at the angle axis'. Default true. |
| `clip` | `boolean` | Clip series to the plot's outline. Default true. |
| `insets` | `Partial<Insets>` | Fixed margins round the plot (room for axes). |

**In** Chart · **Holds** as CartesianPlane

| `sweep` | `number` | Radians swept by the angle axis, clockwise; negative runs the other way. Default 2π. |

## Axis

Positions data along one side of a plane, with ticks and labels.

**In** a plane · **Holds** 1 scale (required)

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `orientation` | `AxisOrientation` | The side of the plot the axis sits on. Default: 'bottom' for the first axis in a plane, then 'left', 'top', 'right'. |
| `titlePosition` | `Side` | The edge of the plot the title sits at: past the axis' labels for an axis fixed to that side, otherwise at the middle of the edge, outside any axes there, which then take the room it needs. Default: the axis' own side. |
| `titleDirection` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | Whether the title runs along the horizontal or the vertical. Default: horizontal at the top and bottom, vertical at the left and right. |
| `crossesAt` | `number` | Float across the plot at this value of the crossing axis (the other one, or `crossAxis`), instead of sitting on a side. |
| `crossAxis` | `ElementRef<Axis>` | The axis `crossesAt` is a value of. Default: the plane's first axis on the other orientation. |
| `min` | `number` | Fix an end of the range. |
| `max` | `number` | Fix the top end of the range. |
| `include` | `readonly number[]` | Values the range must cover, e.g. `[0]` to anchor a bar-like axis at zero. |
| `padding` | `number` | Extra room at both ends as a fraction of the data's span. |
| `nice` | `boolean` | Round the ends outwards to tidy tick values. |
| `inverted` | `boolean` | Run from max to min along the axis. |
| `title` | `string` | The axis title (or, on a `ColorAxis` or `SizeAxis`, the default title of its key). Default: none. |
| `tickCount` | `number` | Ask for about this many ticks, whatever the length. |
| `ticks` | `readonly number[] \| ((range: Readonly<Extent>) => readonly …` | Put ticks exactly here (those inside the range are drawn), or at whatever a function of the range returns. |
| `tickStep` | `number` | Put ticks at every multiple of this step. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` | Turns a tick's number into its label, e.g. (v) => `${v}%`. Default: plain digits, grouped by `locale` if one is set. |
| `locale` | `string` | A BCP 47 tag for how this writes its numbers (grouping and decimal mark). Default: the chart's `locale`, else plain digits. |
| `onViewChange` | `(view: Readonly<Extent> \| null) => void` | Called when the view (what pan, zoom or a reset has set) changes: the new range, or null when it is back to the natural one. |

| `padding` | `number` | Extra room at both ends as a fraction of the data's span. |
| `nice` | `boolean` | Round the ends outwards to tidy tick values. |
| `inverted` | `boolean` | Run from max to min along the axis. |
| `title` | `string` | The axis title (or, on a `ColorAxis` or `SizeAxis`, the default title of its key). Default: none. |
| `tickCount` | `number` | Ask for about this many ticks, whatever the length. |
| `ticks` | `readonly number[] \| ((range: Readonly<Extent>) => readonly …` | Put ticks exactly here (those inside the range are drawn), or at whatever a function of the range returns. |
| `tickStep` | `number` | Put ticks at every multiple of this step. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` | Turns a tick's number into its label, e.g. (v) => `${v}%`. Default: plain digits, grouped by `locale` if one is set. |
| `locale` | `string` | A BCP 47 tag for how this writes its numbers (grouping and decimal mark). Default: the chart's `locale`, else plain digits. |
| `onViewChange` | `(view: Readonly<Extent> \| null) => void` | Called when the view (what pan, zoom or a reset has set) changes: the new range, or null when it is back to the natural one. |

## ColorKey

Shows what a ColorAxis means.

**In** Chart · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `thickness` | `number` | Thickness of the colour bar in pixels. Default 14. |
| `dimension` (required) | `ElementRef<Dimension>` | The dimension this key shows, or its id. |
| `side` | `Side` | The edge of the chart it sits along. Default 'right'. |
| `orientation` | `KeyOrientation` | Which way its scale runs. Default: along its side, so vertical on the left and right, horizontal on the top and bottom. |
| `title` | `string` | Default: the dimension's own title. |
| `length` | `number` | Length of the scale in pixels. Default 140. |
| `breadth` | `number` | Width of a vertical key: the scale and its labels. Default 72. |

**In** Chart · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |

## LinearScale

Equal steps in the data are equal steps on the page.

**In** an axis · **Holds** none

No attributes of its own.

## LogScale

Logarithmic.

**In** an axis · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `base` | `number` | Default 10. |

## SqrtScale

Square root: gives zero a place.

**In** an axis · **Holds** none

No attributes of its own.

## BandScale

Categories in equal bands.

**In** an axis · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `categories` (required) | `readonly string[]` | Category labels in order; the domain values are indexes into this list. |
| `gap` | `number` | Fraction of each band left empty between neighbours, 0..1. Default 0.2. |

## IntlTimeScale

Timestamps on the calendar, with Date and Intl.

**In** an axis · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `locale` | `string` | The language the labels are written in (a BCP 47 tag). Default: the runtime's. |
| `timeZone` | `string` | An IANA time zone name, 'UTC' or 'local' (the runtime's). Default 'UTC'. |
| `weekStart` | `number` | The first day of a week, 0 for Sunday to 6. Default 1, Monday. |
| `formats` | `Partial<Record<TimeRank, Format>>` | Replaces the default format of a rank. |

## TemporalTimeScale

Timestamps on the calendar, with Temporal.

**In** an axis · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `locale` | `string` | The language the labels are written in (a BCP 47 tag). Default: the runtime's. |
| `temporal` | `Opaque<TemporalLike>` | Where `Temporal` comes from, when the runtime has none. |
| `timeZone` | `string` | An IANA time zone name, 'UTC' or 'local' (the runtime's). Default 'UTC'. |
| `weekStart` | `number` | The first day of a week, 0 for Sunday to 6. Default 1, Monday. |
| `formats` | `Partial<Record<TimeRank, Format>>` | Replaces the default format of a rank. |

## DomainSeries

A value at each position along a domain.

**In** a plane or Stack · **Holds** 1 data (source or Decimator), then any renderers

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `domainAxis` | `ElementRef<Axis>` | Default: the plane's first axis (a Cartesian plane's horizontal one, a polar plane's angle). |
| `valueAxis` | `ElementRef<Axis>` | Default: the plane's second axis (the vertical one, the radius). |
| `name` | `string` | What the series is called where it is named: a tooltip's heading. |
| `hit` | `false \| HitMode \| HitOptions` | How pointer hits find this series: a mode name, options, or `false` for a series that should never be hit (a selection overlay, a reference line). |
| `gaps` | `'break' \| 'connect' \| 'zero'` | What a missing value (NaN, or infinite) means. 'break' (default): nothing is there, so a line stops and starts again and an area splits. 'connect': the line goes straight across to the next value there is. 'zero': the value is 0 (and the axis reaches it). |

## XYSeries

Points with x and y both from the data.

**In** a plane · **Holds** 1 data, then any renderers

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `x` (required) | `Channel` | The channel of the source that is x. |
| `xAxis` | `ElementRef<Axis>` | Default: the plane's first axis (a Cartesian plane's horizontal one). |
| `yAxis` | `ElementRef<Axis>` | Default: the plane's second axis (the vertical one). |
| `name` | `string` | What the series is called where it is named: a tooltip's heading. |
| `hit` | `false \| HitMode \| HitOptions` | How pointer hits find this series: a mode name, options, or `false` for a series that should never be hit (a selection overlay, a reference line). |
| `gaps` | `'break' \| 'connect' \| 'zero'` | What a missing value (NaN, or infinite) means. 'break' (default): nothing is there, so a line stops and starts again and an area splits. 'connect': the line goes straight across to the next value there is. 'zero': the value is 0 (and the axis reaches it). |

## Stack

Series that share axes and are laid on each other or side by side.

**In** a plane · **Holds** DomainSeries, any number

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `StackMode` | How the members' values are laid out. Default 'stack'. |
| `align` | `StackAlign` | How rows are matched up when the members' domains differ. Default 'strict': they must not. |

## FlatDataSource

Numbers in an array or typed array, read in place.

**In** a series · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `data` (required) | `ArrayLike<number>` | Float64Array, Float32Array, or any numeric array. |
| `stride` | `number` | Numbers per point. Default 2 (x, y pairs), or 1 when `regularDomain` is set. |
| `domainOffset` | `number` | Where the domain and the value sit within a point's `stride` numbers. Default 0 and 1 (0 when there is no stored domain). |
| `valueOffset` | `number` | Where the value sits within a point's `stride` numbers. Default 1 (0 when there is no stored domain). |
| `count` | `number` | Number of points. Default: `data.length / stride`. |
| `regularDomain` | `{ start: number; step: number }` | Evenly spaced domain with no stored x values: a y-only array. |
| `channels` | `Readonly<Record<Channel, number>>` | Extra columns that bindings can address by name, as offsets within a point's `stride` numbers. |
| `isSorted` | `boolean` | The stored points already ascend in the domain. Default false. |
| `wrap` | `number` | The domain repeats with this period, and the source delivers one more point: the first, again, one period on. |

## ObjectDataSource

Rows as objects, read by property name.

**In** a series · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `source` (required) | `readonly Row[]` |  |
| `domain` | `Field<Row>` | Where each row is along the domain. |
| `value` (required) | `Field<Row>` |  |
| `channels` | `Readonly<Record<Channel, Field<Row>>>` | Extra columns that bindings can address by name: a size, a colour, a category, the x of an XY plot. |
| `isSorted` | `boolean` | The stored points already ascend in the domain. Default false. |
| `wrap` | `number` | The domain repeats with this period, and the source delivers one more point: the first, again, one period on. |

## CompositeDataSource

Separate columns.

**In** a series · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `count` (required) | `number` |  |
| `domain` (required) | `Column` | Where each row is along the domain: for a made-up domain, `(i) => start + step * i`. |
| `value` (required) | `Column` |  |
| `channels` | `Readonly<Record<Channel, Column>>` | Extra columns that bindings and tooltips can address by name. |
| `isSorted` | `boolean` | The stored points already ascend in the domain. Default false. |
| `wrap` | `number` | The domain repeats with this period, and the source delivers one more point: the first, again, one period on. |

## SyntheticDataSource

A function sampled when drawn.

**In** a series · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `fn` (required) | `(x: number) => number` | Value at a domain position. |
| `domain` (required) | `Extent` | The span the function is defined over: the data's whole domain. |
| `count` | `number` | Number of samples, evenly spaced across the domain, always. |
| `isSorted` | `boolean` | The stored points already ascend in the domain. Default false. |
| `wrap` | `number` | The domain repeats with this period, and the source delivers one more point: the first, again, one period on. |

## Decimator

Reduces large data to what the plot can show.

**In** a series · **Holds** 1 kernel, then 1 source

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `resolution` | `number` | Pixel columns reduced to per pixel of plot width. Default 1; raise it for high-DPI output. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | Turn it off without removing it. Default true. |

## MinMaxKernel

Keeps the lowest and highest of each pixel column.

**In** Decimator · **Holds** none

No attributes of its own.

## M4Kernel

**In** Decimator · **Holds** none

No attributes of its own.

## LttbKernel

Largest-triangle-three-buckets: keeps the shape.

**In** Decimator · **Holds** none

No attributes of its own.

## StrideKernel

Every nth point.

**In** Decimator · **Holds** none

No attributes of its own.

## LinePath

A line through the points.

**In** a series · **Holds** 1 curve (required)

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `stroke` | `string` | Outline colour (a CSS colour). Default: from the theme. |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` | Outline width in pixels. Default: from the theme. |
| `fill` | `string` | Fill colour (a CSS colour; 'none' for no fill). Default: from the theme. |
| `opacity` | `number` | Opacity from 0 to 1. Default 1. |
| `bind` | `Bindings<Bindable>` | Attributes fed from data instead of fixed. |
| `maxNodes` | `number` | Most paths this renderer may create. Default 1000. |

## AreaPath

The region between a line and a baseline.

**In** a series · **Holds** 1 curve (required)

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `baseline` | `number` | The value the area is filled from, kept inside the value axis' range. Default 0. |
| `stroke` | `string` | Outline colour (a CSS colour). Default: from the theme. |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` | Outline width in pixels. Default: from the theme. |
| `fill` | `string` | Fill colour (a CSS colour; 'none' for no fill). Default: from the theme. |

## Density

Bins points over any number of dimensions: count, sum, mean, fraction, density per bin (a histogram with BarPath).

**In** a series · **Holds** 1 data

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `by` | `readonly string[]` | The dimensions to bin: 'domain', 'value' or channel names. Default ['domain']. |
| `weight` | `string` | What each point counts for: a channel name or 'value'. Default: 1 for each point. |
| `stat` | `Stat` | The value of a one-dimensional output: 'count', 'sum', 'mean', 'fraction' (the share of the total, 0 to 1) or 'density'. Default 'count', or 'sum' with a `weight`. |
| `width` | `number \| readonly number[]` | Bin size in each dimension's units: one number for all, or one for each dimension. |
| `bins` | `number \| readonly number[]` | Number of bins in each dimension, spread evenly over its extent (by default the data's own range). |
| `origin` | `number \| readonly number[]` | Where a bin edge falls when `width` is used, in each dimension: edges are at `origin` plus whole widths. Default 0. |
| `extent` | `Extent \| readonly (Extent \| null)[]` | The span to bin over in each dimension, as `{ min, max }` (one for all, or an array with one for each); points outside are left out. Default: the data's extent. |
| `maxBins` | `number` | Most bins along a dimension when the size is chosen by the rule. Default 200. |
| `empty` | `'keep' \| 'omit'` | 'keep' bins with no points as zeros, 'omit' leaves them out. Default 'keep' for one dimension, 'omit' for more. |

Local linear regression: `smoothness` 0 joins the points, 1 is the line.

## PointAnnotations

A note beside each chosen point: its words, a box or a callout.

**In** a plane · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `text` (required) | `(hit: Hit, words: PointWords) => string \| null \| undefined` | What a point's note says, or nothing (`null`, `undefined` or an empty string) for a point that gets none. |
| `anchor` | `ElementRef<AnySeriesRenderer>` | The renderer that says where each point is, and so which series the notes are for: its id, or the element. |
| `series` | `ElementRef<Series>` | The series, when there is no `anchor` (the notes then go beside the series' points), or to say which series when the anchor is not enough. Default: the anchor's series, else the plane's first. |
| `contain` | `boolean` | Keep every note within the plot. Default true. |
| `shape` | `'text' \| 'box' \| 'callout'` | What is drawn: just 'text', 'box' (text in a box, the default) or a 'callout' (a box with an arm to the point). |
| `placement` | `'outside' \| 'inside' \| 'auto'` | Where a note goes from its anchor. 'outside' (the default) beyond it, away from what is drawn there (above the end of a bar that grows up, below one that grows down); 'inside' at it, towards the foot; 'auto' tries the eight directions round the point and takes the spot with the least in the way, as a `CalloutAnnotation` does. |
| `offset` | `number` | Pixels between a note and its anchor. Default: the callout's own `offset`. |
| `maxCount` | `number` | The most notes drawn; further points that have one are left out (`omitted` says how many). Default 40. |
| `aria` | `'hidden' \| 'text'` | Whether assistive technology reads the notes. 'hidden' (the default) when they repeat what the chart's table and summary say; 'text' when `text` carries something they do not, which is for you to judge. |

## PanZoom

Drag, wheel, pinch, touch and keys change the view.

**In** a plane · **Holds** none

| Attribute | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `axes` | `readonly ElementRef<Axis>[]` | The axes it may move, as elements or ids. Default: all of the plane's that can be dragged along: not the rim of a polar or radar plane. |
| `direction` | `'both' \| 'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | Which way things may move. Default 'both'. |
| `pan` | `boolean` | Drag with the primary button to pan. Default true. |
| `zoom` | `boolean` | Turn the wheel to zoom about the pointer. Default true. |
| `limit` | `boolean` | Keep the view inside the natural range of each axis, so there is no panning off the data or zooming out past it. Default true. |
| `zoomSpeed` | `number` | Zoom per wheel pixel, as a natural-log factor. Default 0.002, which is about 20% for one notch of a typical wheel. |
| `axisZoom` | `boolean` | With the pointer (or both fingers) over an axis, a wheel turn, a pinch or a drag moves that axis alone. Default true. |
| `pinchSpeed` | `number` | Zoom per pixel of a pinch on a trackpad, which browsers report as small wheel turns with Ctrl held. Default 0.02, ten times the wheel's step per pixel. |
| `touch` | `'two-finger' \| 'always'` | What a touch does. 'two-finger' (the default): one finger scrolls the page as usual, and two pinch and pan the chart. 'always': one finger pans the chart too, and the page cannot be scrolled from it. |
| `inertia` | `boolean` | A finger that lets go while still moving carries the view on, slowing to a stop (a flick). Default true. |
| `resetOnDoubleClick` | `boolean` | Two quick presses put every axis back to its natural range. Default true. |
| `keys` | `PanZoomKeys \| false` | The keys, once the plot has keyboard focus. |
| `keyStep` | `number` | How far an arrow moves the view, as a fraction of it. Default 0.1. |
| `keyZoom` | `number` | The factor of one press of a zoom key. Default 1.25. |
